items.title: Paddock's own programs
items.evidence: Last 10 drives: dashboard 12 % of one core, browser 34 %, overlays 15 %, sim 4.2 cores (all its threads together).

items.title: Lower our own programs' priority during sessions
items.evidence: On. The comparison showed it helps. Helped: 104 to 110 fps on average, 1 % low 86 to 90.

items.title: CrewChief
items.evidence: Used 2 % of one core. Left alone on purpose: its spotter calls must stay on time.

items.title: Other programs during dips
items.evidence: Nothing else stood out during dips (4 drives with dips).

items.title: OneDrive
items.evidence: OneDrive not busy in the last 10 drives.

items.title: Windows power plan
items.evidence: Windows is on the High performance plan.

items.title: Hardware GPU scheduling
items.say: To try it off: run perf-hags-off.cmd and restart the PC.

items.title: iRacing graphics (compared, never changed)
items.say: Ask Claude to put them back.

items.title: Memory
items.evidence: Memory fetched from disk 15 times a second on average, last 5 sessions.

items.title: Connection (online sessions)
items.evidence: Ping 97 ms, connection 100 %, last 5 online sessions.

items.title: Paddock's frame-rate sampler
items.evidence: Costs 7.8 ms of processor time every 5 seconds: 0.156 % of one core while the sim runs. (Budget: 0.2 %.)
